# SEED_NOTES

**All data in this project is synthetic.** It is generated by `database/seed.py` (fixed RNG seed 42, Faker `en_IN`
names) and does not describe any real company, customer, or product. Regenerating gives identical data.

Shape: 2024-10-01 → 2026-09-30 (24 months), ~50k orders, ~99k order lines, 4,000 customers, 20 stores
(one per city, 5 regions), 73 products in 6 categories. Amounts are in INR.

## Injected patterns (so "why" questions have real answers)

| # | Pattern | Mechanism in `seed.py` | Where it shows |
|---|---------|------------------------|----------------|
| 1 | **South India revenue dip in the latest quarter** (Q2 FY2027, Jul–Sep 2026) | From 2026-07-01, Electronics items are picked at 0.30× weight for South-region customers (`SOUTH_ELECTRONICS_WEIGHT`) | South Electronics revenue ≈ ₹43 lakh in Q2 FY27 vs ≈ ₹126 lakh in Q1 FY27; South total ≈ ₹145 lakh vs ≈ ₹233 lakh (Completed orders, as generated) |
| 2 | **Store closure** | Store "Chennai Central" closes 2026-07-20. Afterwards 40% of its would-be store orders move to Online, 60% are lost (`CLOSURE_SHIFT_ONLINE`) | Zero Store-channel orders at Chennai Central after 2026-07-20; Chennai-city revenue falls |
| 3 | **Festive seasonality** | Diwali windows (±10 days around 2024-11-01 and 2025-10-20) ×1.45 on volume; Oct–Dec monthly multipliers 1.25/1.20/1.15 | Order peaks in Oct–Nov |
| 4 | **Festive sale discounts** | 2025-10-10 → 2025-11-05: +10 pts discount (+15 for Electronics), capped at 40% | Higher `discount_pct`, lower margin in that window |
| 5 | **Online share growth** | Probability an order is Online grows linearly 30% → 45% | Online share rises over the 24 months |
| 6 | **West India expansion** | West-region customer activity grows linearly by +50% across the window (`WEST_GROWTH`) | West revenue trends upward faster than other regions |
| 7 | **Category return rates** | Order return probability: Apparel 12%, Furniture 10%, Electronics 4%, others 1–5%; 3.5% of orders Cancelled | Returned/Cancelled share by category |
| 8 | **Organic growth + weekly rhythm** | +25% volume ramp over the window; weekends ×1.2–1.25 | Gentle upward trend; weekend peaks |
| 9 | **Corporate baskets** | Corporate-segment customers can buy up to 10 units per line | Higher revenue per order for Corporate |

Customers per city are weighted by rough city size; a minority (~20%) sign up during the window and only order after
their `signup_date`. Customer activity is log-normal, so a few customers order much more often.

Revenue conventions that interact with these patterns (Completed orders only, region = customer's region) are
defined in `retrieval/docs/kpi_definitions.md`.
